overview.en:
Use Uniform’s official local MCP package to inspect and manage project components, content types, patterns, entries and compositions.

Review structured content in the correct project and locale before preparing edits. Keep content models, existing entries, and proposed publishing work distinguishable.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Uniform 官方本地 MCP 包查看和管理项目组件、内容类型、模式、条目与页面组合。

准备编辑前，先在正确项目和语言下查看结构化内容，区分内容模型、现有条目与拟议发布工作。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available content for this page and summarize what needs updating.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这个页面的可用内容，汇总需要更新的部分。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a revised content draft based on this brief and existing structure.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 依据这份简报和现有结构准备内容修改稿。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the available entries for this campaign and identify inconsistencies.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这个活动的可用内容条目，找出不一致之处。
